title: elisma natans var. terrestre
intro: Elisma natans var. terrestre, commonly known as the terrestrial elisma, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Lamiaceae. It is a creeping herb with a wide range of potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Elisma natans var. terrestre include its use as a diuretic, antispasmodic, and expectorant, which can help to relieve symptoms of respiratory issues and promote the removal of excess fluids from the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
